entries.3a8891ee75e44b03: This is a collection of businesses not included in reportable segments, comprising the engineering, green energy development and building lifecycle businesses conducted by SHIMIZU CORPORATION itself, and various businesses conducted by subsidiaries other than Nippon Road Co., Ltd. The engineering business handles renewable energy, production facilities for advanced and strategic products, and environmental remediation, and the company says it is focusing on EPC work for offshore wind power facilities and the operation of SEP vessels. The green energy development business is advancing power source development and electricity retail for renewable energy, as well as the development and implementation of the hydrogen utilization technology “Hydro Q-BiC.” The building lifecycle business provides building maintenance and services to extend building lifespans. Among subsidiaries, Milux Co., Ltd. sells and leases construction materials and equipment, SC Machinery Co., Ltd. rents out construction machinery, Shimizu Finance Co., Ltd. lends funds to group companies, and Tama Medical Campus Co., Ltd. and others conduct PFI business for public facilities.
